purpose: City-specific discovery of an official cadastral parcel source for Togechane, Ethiopia; unsuccessful access and extent outcomes are not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
name: Togechane

queries.query: Togechane Ethiopia cadastral parcel map land registry official
queries.result: Search located Ethiopia's official e-Land cadastral viewer and Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure land/cadastre material. The e-Land configuration and public WFS are explicitly Addis-Ababa AA-ADS scoped; no Togechane-local service was identified.
Search returned the official Addis e-Land cadastral service and general Ethiopian land-registration policy material, but no Togechane-specific local registry or public parcel endpoint.

registryBasis: No Togechane-local registry, cadastral map, or procedure was evidenced. Ethiopia-wide Ministry material and the Addis-Ababa e-Land service were not treated as local custodian evidence.

officialSources.operator: Addis Ababa City Administration Landholding Registration and Information Agency
officialSources.scope: Official e-Land portal; its published configuration names AA-ADS, Addis, workspace ncrprs_cadaster, and a registered-parcel WFS.

officialSources.operator: Addis Ababa City Administration Landholding Registration and Information Agency
officialSources.scope: Current public JavaScript configuration inspected; gsUrl/wfsUrl and cityCode are Addis-specific.

officialSources.operator: Ethiopian Ministry of Urban and Infrastructure
officialSources.scope: General national land/cadastre agency information, not Togechane-local source evidence.

routesAttempted.outcome: 200; public map HTML loaded. Current JavaScript/configuration was followed to the public GeoServer route.
200; schema/config inspected. Production wfsUrl is ncrprs_cadaster:v_1_registered_parcel with EPSG:4326 and cityCode AA-ADS.
200; WFS capabilities loaded and registered-parcel layer confirmed.

200; bounded WFS GetFeature against ncrprs_cadaster:v_1_registered_parcel, EPSG:4326, bbox=43.3320,9.5958,43.3330,9.5968, maxFeatures=3, propertyName=uniqueparcelid returned FeatureCollection totalFeatures=0. This is an extent response only, not a citywide absence finding.

200; bounded Addis control request returned one MultiPolygon with safe native field uniqueparcelid=AA000010100005, confirming the endpoint can return ID-plus-geometry, but it is outside Togechane and was not retained as a sample.
200; initial Togechane request using unsupported propertyName=parcel_id returned an InvalidParameterValue schema error listing available fields. No unsafe fields were requested.

schemaCrsAndResponse.reason: No Togechane-area feature was returned; no polygon was retained.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.
The zero bounded response is not evidence of citywide absence or lack of cadastral coverage.
The discovered e-Land service is Addis-Ababa-specific and does not establish a Togechane adapter.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only, not source integration or admission.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID if independently verified
remainingUncertainty: A Somali Region/Dire Dawa or other local custodian service may exist outside the Addis e-Land deployment and may require separate discovery. The exact-point/extent miss cannot resolve that uncertainty.
